card.text: WASP-5 b was found in 2008 by SuperWASP as it crossed its star.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "WASP-5b"
sources.quote: WASP-5b is an exoplanet orbiting the star WASP-5 located approximately 1000 light-years away in the constellation Phoenix.

introduction.text: It is the only planet known around WASP-5. Its orbit and size follow Gillon et al. 2009's fit, the archive's default.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "WASP-5b"
sources.quote: The planet's mass and radius indicate that it is a gas giant with a similar bulk composition to Jupiter.
